deviations.issue: Dedicated SR controller (UCC24610 or similar) likely not in JLCPCB Extended catalog
deviations.impact: Cannot use integrated SR controller IC
deviations.mitigation: Use transformer-coupled gate drive OR discrete comparator + gate driver solution. Common approach: sense transformer voltage, use comparator to detect conduction interval, drive gates with IR2110-style driver.
deviations.assembly_impact: Requires discrete implementation instead of single IC. Adds ~3-4 components per SR channel.

deviations.issue: Low-value current sense resistors in SMD packages may be limited in JLCPCB Basic
deviations.impact: May need to use Extended parts or larger footprints
deviations.mitigation: Search for 10mΩ 2512 or larger packages in Extended. Alternative: omit current sensing if not required for control.
deviations.assembly_impact: Extended parts add cost. Current sensing is optional for basic operation.

assembly_feasibility: PARTIAL - SR MOSFETs assemblable, dedicated SR controller likely requires discrete implementation
